items.title: Ark's Wood Favors Nvidia, AMD in 'Volatile' Chip Cycle
items.title_ko: Ark's Wood Favors Nvidia, AMD in 'Volatile' Chip Cycle
items.summary_ko: Cathie Wood, founder, CEO and CIO of Ark Investment Management, discusses why she avoids traditional memory-chip players, saying the business cycle is "most volatile." Speaking on Bloomberg Television, Wood adds that we are "just at the beginning" of the artificial intelligence revolution. "In terms of our semiconductor exposure, [we] tend to be at the less-cyclical end of the spectrum," she adds.

items.title: ASML Raises Full-Year Sales Outlook
items.summary_ko: ASML upgraded the low end of its 2026 sales forecast as increasing artificial intelligence spending boosts demand for the Dutch company’s chip-making machines. The firm projected annual sales of between €44 billion ($49 billion) and €45 billion this year.
